claim: tests/test_skill_sync.py is excluded from the cli-tests check because it checks machine-local skill mirrors (machine hygiene, not code) and would wrongly charge failures to tasks that edit a skill.

citations.quote: It is machine hygiene, not a code check; it still runs in an ordinary `pytest tests/`.

A task that edits a skill would fail
  it until someone runs `py -3.11 scripts/sync_skills.py`, and the failure would be charged to the
  task.
